properties.title: Habshan–Fujairah oil pipeline (ADCOP)
properties.desc: SCHEMATIC. UAE. 406 km, 1.5 million bbl/d; lets Abu Dhabi crude reach the Gulf of Oman without transiting Hormuz. Operating since 2012.
properties.src: Wikipedia "Habshan–Fujairah oil pipeline" (route nodes, status); Wikidata P625 (node coordinates)

properties.title: Dolphin Gas Pipeline
properties.desc: SCHEMATIC. Qatar to UAE: Ras Laffan to Taweelah offshore, then Taweelah to Fujairah (244 km). Qatar's gas export link to the UAE and Oman.
properties.src: Wikipedia "Dolphin Gas Project" (route nodes, status); Wikidata P625 (node coordinates)

properties.title: East–West (Petroline) crude pipeline
properties.desc: SCHEMATIC. Saudi Arabia, ~1,200 km, Abqaiq to Yanbu on the Red Sea; bypasses Hormuz. Stated capacity 7 million bbl/d. Hit by drone attacks in 2026; restarted 22 Sep 2026 at reduced volume.
properties.src: Wikipedia "East–West Crude Oil Pipeline" (route nodes, status); Wikidata P625 (node coordinates)

properties.title: Kirkuk–Ceyhan oil pipeline (Iraq–Turkey)
properties.desc: SCHEMATIC. Iraq to Turkey, ~970 km, design capacity 1.5 million bbl/d. Halted March 2023, resumed Sept 2025; one-year Iraq-Turkey extension signed Aug 2026.
properties.src: Wikipedia "Kirkuk–Ceyhan Oil Pipeline" (route nodes, status); Wikidata P625 (node coordinates)

properties.title: Baku–Tbilisi–Ceyhan (BTC) pipeline
properties.desc: SCHEMATIC. Azerbaijan, Georgia, Turkey. 1,768 km, about 1 million bbl/d; routes Caspian oil past Russia and Armenia. Operating since 2006.
properties.src: Wikipedia "Baku–Tbilisi–Ceyhan pipeline" (route nodes, status); Wikidata P625 (node coordinates)

properties.title: TurkStream
properties.desc: SCHEMATIC. Russia to Turkey under the Black Sea, ~930 km offshore, 31.5 bcm/yr on two lines; onward to Bulgaria. Operating since Jan 2020.
properties.src: Wikipedia "TurkStream" (route nodes, status); Wikidata P625 (node coordinates)

properties.title: Power of Siberia
properties.desc: SCHEMATIC. Russia to China via Blagoveshchensk, phase 1 ~2,156 km. Stated full capacity 61 bcm/yr, of which 38 bcm/yr to China. Deliveries since Dec 2019.
properties.src: Wikipedia "Power of Siberia" (route nodes, status); Wikidata P625 (node coordinates)

properties.title: Druzhba pipeline, southern branch
properties.desc: SCHEMATIC. Russia, Belarus, Ukraine, Slovakia, Hungary. Southern branch of a ~4,000 km system (1.2-1.4 million bbl/d). Halted by attacks in Jan 2026; flows back to normal by May 2026.
properties.src: Wikipedia "Druzhba pipeline" (route nodes, status); Wikidata P625 (node coordinates)

properties.title: Druzhba pipeline, northern branch
properties.desc: SCHEMATIC. Russia, Belarus, Poland, Germany: Mazyr to the Płock and Schwedt refineries. Russian supply to Germany ended Jan 2023 and to Poland Feb 2023.
properties.src: Wikipedia "Druzhba pipeline" (route nodes, status); Wikidata P625 (node coordinates)

properties.title: Trans Adriatic Pipeline (TAP)
properties.desc: SCHEMATIC. Greece, Albania, Italy; 878 km, 10 bcm/yr initial capacity. Final leg of the Southern Gas Corridor; operating since Nov 2020.
properties.src: Wikipedia "Trans Adriatic Pipeline" (route nodes, status); Wikidata P625 (node coordinates)

properties.title: Maghreb–Europe Gas Pipeline (GME)
properties.desc: SCHEMATIC. Algeria, Morocco, Spain; 1,620 km, 12 bcm/yr when running. Not in operation since Algeria let the contract lapse on 31 Oct 2021; a section was reversed in June 2022 to export gas to Morocco.
properties.src: Wikipedia "Maghreb–Europe Gas Pipeline" (route nodes, status); Wikidata P625 (node coordinates)

properties.title: Trans-Mediterranean (TransMed) pipeline
properties.desc: SCHEMATIC. Algeria, Tunisia, Italy: Algerian gas via Cap Bon, Sicily and the Strait of Messina to Minerbio; a branch serves Slovenia.
properties.src: Wikipedia "Trans-Mediterranean Pipeline" (route nodes, status); Wikidata P625 (node coordinates)

properties.title: Medgaz
properties.desc: SCHEMATIC. Algeria to Spain, 757 km; capacity expanded from 8 to 10.5 bcm/yr. Operating since 2011; Algeria's direct route to Spain.
properties.src: Wikipedia "Medgaz" (route nodes, status); Wikidata P625 (node coordinates)

properties.title: Keystone Pipeline (Phases I-III)
properties.desc: SCHEMATIC. Canada and US: Hardisty (Alberta) to Nederland (Texas); Phase III 700,000 bbl/d. Operating. Keystone XL (Phase IV) was cancelled in 2021 and is not shown.
properties.src: Wikipedia "Keystone Pipeline" (route nodes, status); Wikidata P625 (node coordinates)

properties.title: Trans-Alaska Pipeline System (TAPS)
properties.desc: SCHEMATIC. Alaska, ~800 miles (1,300 km) from Prudhoe Bay to the Valdez Marine Terminal, with 12 pump stations. Operating.
properties.src: Wikipedia "Trans-Alaska Pipeline System" (route nodes, status); Wikidata P625 (node coordinates)

properties.title: TAPI pipeline (Turkmenistan–Afghanistan–Pakistan–India)
properties.desc: SCHEMATIC. ~1,814 km planned, 33 bcm/yr. Under construction, not operating: Turkmen section completed 2024, Afghan work under way, Herat targeted by end-2026.
properties.src: Wikipedia "Turkmenistan–Afghanistan–Pakistan–India Pipeline" (route nodes, status); Wikidata P625 (node coordinates)

properties.title: Trans-Anatolian gas pipeline (TANAP), Turkish section
properties.desc: SCHEMATIC. Azerbaijani gas across Turkey, drawn from Erzurum to the Greek border at Kipoi where it joins TAP; initial capacity 16 bcm/yr. Inaugurated June 2018.
properties.src: Wikipedia "Trans-Anatolian gas pipeline" (route nodes, status); Wikidata P625 (node coordinates)
